name: Eastern Hognose Snake
desc: Eastern Hognose Snake (Heterodon platirhinos): hunts or scavenges other animals. Recorded 21 times near the park in GBIF.
about: The eastern hog-nosed snake is a species of mildly venomous rear-fanged snake in the family Colubridae. The venom is specifically adapted to amphibian prey and is harmless to humans.
